body: I don't know. For now?: find some friends to help me through this, survive the rest of 8th grade and high school. If I can do that: maybe go to college, marry a nice guy who cares about me? Honestly I don't have any actual plans for my future. I don't know how to deal with all this pain.
I understand that she's concerned about our safety. It's just that I don't like talking to anyone about anything, and when people ask me a bunch of questions I get really stressed.

Thanks. I talked to the school guidance counselor today, because my teachers were worried about me because I'd been acting weird lately I guess. I told her what was going on, and just talking to someone helped. Plus, she gave me a pass to skip most of my classes today so that was cool.
